explication: Firecrawl is a web-data API for AI agents: clients request search, scraping, discovery, and asynchronous jobs, then receive web content in LLM-ready formats. The map covers the API’s major documented capabilities and selected implementation layers. README statements support the product workflow; source evidence is limited to the excerpts and SOURCE INDEX shown, so unsampled implementation links are omitted rather than inferred.
